what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso living in Ghana, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13319 Burkinabe refugees in Ghana, 3.8% of all refugees from Burkina Faso.
Mali hosts the most Burkinabe refugees, followed by Côte d'Ivoire, Togo and Ghana.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level in some of those years.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Burkina Faso from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 5 refugees.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025, when the figure is at its highest.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ghana.
These are year-end totals for Ghana only, reported to UNHCR.
